description: This file defines an abstract base class 'LookupBase' which provides common validation and comparison methods used for lookup and reference functions in PHPSpreadsheet calculation module.

classes.name: LookupBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing shared validation and comparison logic for lookup functions within PHPSpreadsheet.

methods.name: validateLookupArray
methods.description: Checks if the provided lookup array is an array; throws an exception if not.

methods.name: validateIndexLookup
methods.description: Validates the index number used in lookup functions, ensuring it's numeric, >= 1, and within array bounds.

methods.name: checkMatch
methods.description: Determines if a match condition is met during lookup, considering datatype and exactness.
